continue.note: Continues template processing despite a success template.

csp.note: Changes the script policy (Content Security Policy) of this page: additional script sources, form targets or a different mode. Must come before the first output.

script.description: Additional script sources, separated by spaces or commas (https://js.example.com, *.example.com). Keywords like 'unsafe-inline' are discarded.

form.description: Additional form targets (enables form-action), e.g. the payment provider.

mode.description: Mode for this page: off = no script policy, report = report only, enforce = enforce. Empty: setting of the instance.

date.note: Outputs the date part of a date value, formatted.

id.description: Record to read from. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL.

field.description: Name of a record field whose content is used as the source.

useval.description: Value in text form that is used as the source.

format.description: ICU pattern, e.g. "dd.MM.y". Without specification, the locale of the page determines the notation.

timezone.description: true: The name of the time zone is appended (e.g. "Europe/Berlin").

replace.description: If the text before the question mark occurs in the formatted value, it is replaced by the text after the question mark (e.g. "Jan?January").

ifempty.description: Text that is output if the source ('field' or 'useval') is empty.

instead.description: Text that is output instead of the source, if it is not empty.

prefix.description: Text that is placed before the formatted value, if it is not empty.

suffix.description: Text that is appended if the formatted value is not empty.

set.description: The formatted value is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

datetime.note: Outputs date and time of a date value, formatted.

id.description: Record to read from. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL.

field.description: Name of a record field whose content is used as the source.

useval.description: Value in text form that is used as the source.

format.description: ICU pattern, e.g. "dd.MM.y HH:mm". Without specification, the locale of the page determines the notation.

autotime.description: true: If no time is present (00:00), it is not displayed.

timezone.description: true: The name of the time zone is appended (e.g. "Europe/Berlin").

replace.description: If the text before the question mark occurs in the formatted value, it is replaced by the text after the question mark (e.g. "Jan?January").

ifempty.description: Text that is output if the source ('field' or 'useval') is empty.

instead.description: Text that is output instead of the source, if it is not empty.

prefix.description: Text that is placed before the formatted value, if it is not empty.

suffix.description: Text that is appended if the formatted value is not empty.

set.description: The formatted value is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

email.note: Sends an email. On request, checks the required fields of a form in advance.

formguard.description: true: Form protection against robots - the form must contain the fields from (CMS:USER_TOKEN formguard=true) (timestamp, empty honeypot field) and may be submitted no earlier than after user.formguard_min_seconds (3). A number sets this minimum time for the form (formguard=5); 0 or false switches the protection off. Otherwise message "throttled", as with throttling.

throttle.description: Throttling per origin (IP): true = limit user.throttle.email_ip (5 per hour), otherwise a separate bucket from user.throttle. Throttled: message "throttled", no email. For contact forms in which anyone can enter an address.

to.description: Recipient email address. Several recipients as to[]=… or comma-separated (at most 20).

toname.description: Recipient name (only with exactly one recipient).

subjecttemplate.description: Template for the subject (tags and line breaks are removed). Takes precedence over subject.

bodytemplate.description: Template for the email body. Takes precedence over body.

paths_absolute.description: true: All server-relative paths in the email body are converted into absolute paths (only with contenttype="text/html").

sender_url.description: (Optionally with protocol) + domain, so that server-relative paths can be converted into absolute paths.
sender_url.default: Protocol and main domain of the instance

debug.description: true: The email is written to the log file var/log/{date}_mail-debug.log, but not sent.

requiredfields.description: Specification of the required fields. Field names (index names) in the request array data[…] (see parameter data).

data.description: Name of the request array that contains the data expected by 'requiredfields' (default data, i.e. $_POST['data']).

submit.description: 'requiredfields' is evaluated only if 'submit' contains a value. Otherwise the CMS:EMAIL command is ignored.

successtemplate.description: Template that is included after successful sending; the page then ends (unless with CMS:CONTINUE).

message.description: Error message. In the index: use case (required, to, from, content, attachment, send); in the value: message text.

attachment.description: Files to attach. Path relative to the var directory, only from download/, upload/ and modules/.

fed.note: Creates a button for editing a record when frontend editing is enabled. Requires CMS:FED_SCRIPT on the same page.

id.description: Record that is opened. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL.

info.description: true: The button opens the detail view of the record instead of the input mask.

prefix.description: Text that is output (without a button) before the button.

suffix.description: Text that is output (without a button) after the button.

set.description: The button is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

fed_code.note: Outputs HTML code when frontend editing is enabled.

code.description: HTML code that is output when frontend editing is enabled.

instead.description: Alternative output when frontend editing is disabled.

set.description: The code is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

fed_script.note: Provides the JavaScript function cFED() and the click listener for the buttons from CMS:FED (with the nonce of the page) - once per page, usually in the footer.

set.description: The script block is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

text.description: Line of text that is sent as a header to the browser. Without a value ("Name:"), the header is removed.

overwrite.description: false: A previous header of the same type is not overwritten; a new header is added.

include.note: Includes a template - with caching from the output cache (IncludeCache).

caching.description: The output of the template is cached for this long and then delivered without processing again. Without specification, empty or 0: no cache.

cacheparams.description: Everything the output depends on (record, page, customer …): each value creates its own cache file. Instance and language are taken into account automatically.
cacheparams.value: null, bool, int, string or array (also as a variable: cacheparams=$params)

set.description: The entire output (including the included template) is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

jump_list.note: Creates a page navigation (pagination), for example 1 … 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 … 15.

skip.description: Offset of the current page (number of skipped results). Without a value, the request parameter skip applies.

maximum.description: Number of page links shown at the same time (moving along), not counting the links to the first and last page.

boundaries.description: true: Links to the first and the last page are always shown as soon as they lie outside the moving range.

separator.description: Text between two page links. It is not inserted before and after the omission ('ellipsis').

tpl_link.description: Template for a page link. {page} is replaced by the page number, {href} by the page URL.

tpl_active.description: Template for the current page. {page} is replaced by the page number, {href} by the page URL.

ellipsis.description: Placeholder for omitted pages - appears between a boundary link and the moving range.

replace.description: Simple text replacement in the finished HTML. The separator is the question mark: "search?replace".

prefix.description: Text before the navigation, only if a navigation is output.

suffix.description: Text after the navigation, only if a navigation is output.

ifempty.description: Output if the result fits on a single page, or if the CMS:SELECT has no limit and therefore no navigation is needed.

set.description: The navigation is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

jump_next.note: Creates a link to the next page.

skip.description: Offset of the current page (number of skipped results). Without a value, the request parameter skip applies.

tpl_link.description: Template for the link, as long as there is a next page. {href} is replaced by the target URL.

tpl_inactive.description: Template for the link that cannot be selected, if there is no next page. {href} is replaced here as well.

replace.description: Simple text replacement in the finished HTML. The separator is the question mark: "search?replace".

prefix.description: Text before the link, only if a link is output.

suffix.description: Text after the link, only if a link is output.

ifempty.description: Output if the CMS:SELECT has no limit (then there are no pages). If everything fits on one page, tpl_inactive appears.

set.description: The link is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

jump_prev.note: Creates a link to the previous page.

skip.description: Offset of the current page (number of skipped results). Without a value, the request parameter skip applies.

tpl_link.description: Template for the link, as long as there is a previous page. {href} is replaced by the target URL.

tpl_inactive.description: Template for the link that cannot be selected, if there is no previous page. {href} is replaced here as well.

replace.description: Simple text replacement in the finished HTML. The separator is the question mark: "search?replace".

prefix.description: Text before the link, only if a link is output.

suffix.description: Text after the link, only if a link is output.

ifempty.description: Output if the CMS:SELECT has no limit (then there are no pages). If everything fits on one page, tpl_inactive appears.

set.description: The link is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

media.note: Creates an image tag or outputs the content of a media file in text form.

id.description: Record to read from. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL.

field.description: Name of an upload or thumbnail field.

subfield.description: Single value instead of an IMG tag: path (path from DOCUMENT_ROOT for src/href, with a readable file name; with auth/download/user_auth via file.php), file (absolute path in the file system), filename (original file name), mime_type, extension (without dot), size (bytes; readable with autoformat), width / height (pixels, 0 if unknown), version (version counter of the file).
subfield.value: path / file / filename / mime_type / extension / size / width / height / version

auth.description: true: The link points to /file.php instead of the media directory. For fields with "Only for signed-in frontend users" (user_auth) this applies automatically - file.php checks the frontend session there.

download.description: The file is offered for download via /file.php under the given file name (the file extension is added automatically).

width.description: Width of the IMG tag, with or without a CSS unit (default: px).

height.description: Height of the IMG tag, with or without CSS unit (default: px).

attr.description: Additional attributes for the IMG tag (key: attribute name, value: attribute value).

autoformat.description: true: The content selected via 'subfield' is formatted depending on its type (e.g. file sizes in bytes/KB/MB dynamically according to the value).

instead.description: Overrides the formatted value, if it is not empty.

ifempty.description: Alternative text if the formatted value is empty (or "0").

prefix.description: Text that is placed before the formatted value, if it is not empty (or "0").

suffix.description: Text that is appended if the formatted value is not empty (or "0").

useval.description: File array (e.g. from CMS:SAVEDATA) together with field_id and record_id - only via a direct PHP call, without field (see example).

set.description: The formatted value is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

message.note: Produces a text output from current error messages.

useval.description: Value in text form that is used as the source.

prefix.description: Text that is output before the messages, if there are any.

suffix.description: Text that is output after the messages, if there are any.

ifempty.description: Text if no message is present.

instead.description: Text that is output instead of the messages.

set.description: The message is not displayed, but written to the variable $set.

nonce.note: Outputs the nonce of the page: <script(CMS:NONCE)>. Every script in the template needs it as soon as the script policy of the website is enforced.

format.description: attribute: nonce="…" (with a leading space, for a <script> tag). value: only the value.

set.description: The output is not printed, but stored in the variable $set.

id.description: Record to read from. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL.

field.description: Name of a record field whose content is used as the source.

useval.description: Value in text form that is used as the source.

ifempty.description: Text that is output if the source is empty or the numeric value (after mul/add) is 0.

instead.description: Number that becomes the source, if the original source is not empty.

mul.description: Number by which the source is multiplied.

add.description: Number that is added to the source.

format.description: Formatting analogous to the PHP command sprintf().

decimals.description: Fixed number of decimal places (rounded); decimal and thousands_separator still apply. Without specification, as many as the number has.

decimal.description: Character that replaces the decimal point.

thousands_separator.description: Character inserted as thousands separator (every three digits from right to left).

nullcent.description: Text that replaces a missing decimal value.

replace.description: If the text before the question mark occurs in the formatted value, it is replaced by the text after the question mark (e.g. ".00?" removes empty decimal places).

prefix.description: Text that is placed before the formatted value, if it is not "0" or empty.

suffix.description: Text that is appended to the formatted value, if it is not "0" or empty.

set.description: The formatted value is not output, but stored in the variable $set instead.

sizefactor.description: 1000 or 1024. If > 0, a readable file size is calculated (e.g. 15.2 GB).
sizefactor.value: Number of bytes in a kilobyte

pdf_cell.note: Zelle der aktuellen Zeile. Schrift ist die zu diesem Zeitpunkt eingestellte (CMS:PDF_FONT).

text.description: Zelltext; bricht innerhalb der Spalte um, soweit fit= ihn nicht einpasst.

col.description: Spaltenindex ab 0; ohne Angabe die nächste Spalte.

fit.description: Text auf eine Zeile in der Spaltenbreite einpassen: fontsize verkleinert die Schrift (bis min_size), spacing verringert den Zeichenabstand, scale beides, force staucht horizontal. Was auch so nicht passt, bricht um.

border.description: Rahmenseiten: L links, T oben, R rechts, B unten; 1 alle, 0 keine.

border_color.description: Rahmenfarbe; sonst CMS:PDF_LINE_COLOR. Farbfeld (PDF_COLOR), #rrggbb oder c,m,y,k.

padding.description: Innenabstand dieser Zelle; sonst der der Tabelle.

color.description: Textfarbe; sonst CMS:PDF_TEXT_COLOR. Farbfeld (PDF_COLOR), #rrggbb oder c,m,y,k.

background.description: Hintergrundfarbe der Zelle. Farbfeld (PDF_COLOR), #rrggbb oder c,m,y,k.

pdf_color.note: Definiert ein Farbfeld mit RGB- und/oder CMYK-Wert. Der Farbraum des Dokuments (PDF_INIT) wählt den Wert; ein fehlender wird umgerechnet.

pdf_fill_color.note: Füllfarbe für die folgenden CMS:PDF_RECT. Ohne Angabe Schwarz.

pdf_font.note: Stellt die Schrift für die folgenden Texte und Zellen ein. Gilt über Seiten hinweg.

font.description: Name einer Schrift aus var/modules/pdf/fonts/ ({name}.json; mitgeliefert: helvetica, times, courier, symbol, zapfdingbats). Eine Datei {name}.ttf/.otf wird beim ersten Aufruf konvertiert.

style.description: Schriftschnitt: B fett, I kursiv, U unterstrichen, D durchgestrichen, O überstrichen. Leer = regulär.
style.value: B / I / U / D / O, kombinierbar

pdf_html.note: Schreibt einen HTML-Block (Umbruch und Seitenumbruch durch tc-lib-pdf). Der Cursor bleibt stehen - die Höhe des Blocks ist nicht bekannt.

x.description: Abstand vom linken Seitenrand; ohne Angabe der linke Rand.

y.description: Abstand vom oberen Seitenrand; ohne Angabe der Cursor.

width.description: Breite des Blocks; 0 = bis zum rechten Rand.

pdf_image.note: Platziert ein Bild (JPEG, PNG, GIF, ...) aus dem Medienverzeichnis. Der Cursor rückt unter das Bild.

file.description: Bilddatei: absoluter Pfad aus (CMS:MEDIA subfield=file), Webpfad aus subfield=path oder Pfad relativ zu public/media. Nur Dateien unterhalb des Medienverzeichnisses.

x.description: Abstand vom linken Seitenrand; ohne Angabe der linke Rand.

y.description: Abstand vom oberen Seitenrand; ohne Angabe der Cursor.

width.description: Breite; 0 = aus der Höhe (bzw. aus den Pixeln bei 72 dpi, wenn beide fehlen).

link.description: Verweis, der beim Klick auf das Bild geöffnet wird.

pdf_init.note: Vorgaben für das Dokument: Farbraum, ICC-Profil, Seitenformat und Ränder. Vor der ersten CMS:PDF_PAGE.

colorspace.description: Farbraum, in dem Farben ins PDF geschrieben werden.

icc_profile.description: ICC-Profil aus var/modules/pdf/profiles/, wird als Output Intent eingebettet.

output_condition.description: Bezeichner der Druckbedingung für den Output Intent (z. B. FOGRA39). Ohne Angabe der Dateiname des Profils.

format.description: Seitenformat leerer Seiten (Namen wie in tc-lib-pdf).

margins.description: Seitenränder in mm (ein Wert: alle; zwei: oben/unten, rechts/links). Linker Rand = x-Vorgabe, rechter Rand = Breitenvorgabe, unterer Rand = Umbruchgrenze der Tabellen.

color.description: Linienfarbe; sonst CMS:PDF_LINE_COLOR. Farbfeld (PDF_COLOR), #rrggbb oder c,m,y,k.

pdf_line_color.note: Linienfarbe für die folgenden CMS:PDF_LINE, Rahmen von CMS:PDF_RECT und Zellenrahmen. Ohne Angabe Schwarz.

pdf_page.note: Legt eine neue Seite an - leer oder auf einer Seite einer Layout-Vorlage. Der erste Aufruf beginnt das Dokument.

layout.description: PDF-Vorlage aus var/modules/pdf/layouts/, deren Seite als Hintergrund übernommen wird. Ohne Angabe eine leere Seite.

page.description: Seite der Vorlage (ab 1), die übernommen wird.

format.description: Seitenformat einer leeren Seite; sonst die Vorgabe aus PDF_INIT.

orientation.description: Ausrichtung einer leeren Seite; sonst die Vorgabe aus PDF_INIT.

margins.description: Ränder nur dieser Seite; sonst die Vorgabe aus PDF_INIT.

pdf_print.note: Sendet das Dokument an den Browser und beendet den Request. Vor CMS:PDF_PAGE darf das Template nichts ausgegeben haben.

filename.description: Dateiname, den der Browser anzeigt bzw. beim Speichern vorschlägt.

download.description: Leer oder false: im Browser anzeigen. true: als Download unter filename. Ein Dateiname: als Download unter diesem Namen.

pdf_rect.note: Zeichnet ein Rechteck, umrandet und/oder gefüllt.

style.description: D Rahmen, F Füllung, DF beides.

color.description: Füllfarbe; sonst CMS:PDF_FILL_COLOR. Farbfeld (PDF_COLOR), #rrggbb oder c,m,y,k.

border.description: Rahmenfarbe; sonst CMS:PDF_LINE_COLOR. Farbfeld (PDF_COLOR), #rrggbb oder c,m,y,k.

is_header.description: Kopfzeile: wird nach einem Seitenumbruch auf der Folgeseite wiederholt.

keep_together.description: Zeile nicht über Seiten teilen. Derzeit werden Zeilen grundsätzlich nicht geteilt; der Parameter ist für spätere Versionen reserviert.

pdf_table.note: Beginnt eine Tabelle; Zeilen und Zellen folgen mit CMS:PDF_ROW / CMS:PDF_CELL, gezeichnet wird bei CMS:PDF_TABLE_END. Zeilen werden nie geteilt: was nicht mehr auf die Seite passt, beginnt auf einer Folgeseite, Kopfzeilen werden dort wiederholt.

x.description: Linke Kante; ohne Angabe der linke Rand.

y.description: Obere Kante; ohne Angabe der Cursor.

padding.description: Innenabstand aller Zellen in mm (ein Wert: alle; zwei: oben/unten, rechts/links).

next_layout.description: Layout-Vorlage der Folgeseiten bei Seitenumbruch; sonst wie die letzte CMS:PDF_PAGE (leer = leere Seite).

pdf_table_end.note: Zeichnet die Tabelle. Der Cursor rückt unter die Tabelle.

pdf_text.note: Schreibt einen Textblock mit Zeilenumbruch innerhalb der Breite. Der Cursor rückt unter den Block.

text.description: Der Text (UTF-8; Zeilenumbrüche werden umgebrochen). Leer = keine Ausgabe.

x.description: Abstand vom linken Seitenrand; ohne Angabe der linke Rand.

y.description: Abstand vom oberen Seitenrand (Oberkante des Blocks); ohne Angabe der Cursor.

width.description: Breite des Blocks; 0 = bis zum rechten Rand.

size.description: Schriftgröße nur für diesen Block; sonst die von CMS:PDF_FONT.

color.description: Textfarbe nur für diesen Block; sonst CMS:PDF_TEXT_COLOR. Farbfeld (PDF_COLOR), #rrggbb oder c,m,y,k.

background.description: Hintergrundfarbe des Blocks. Farbfeld (PDF_COLOR), #rrggbb oder c,m,y,k.

pdf_text_color.note: Textfarbe für die folgenden CMS:PDF_TEXT und Zellen. Ohne Angabe Schwarz.

id.description: Record to read from. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL.

field.description: Name of the field whose content is output.

ifempty.description: Text that is output if the field is empty.

instead.description: Text that is output instead of the field content, if it is not empty.

prefix.description: Text that is placed before the field content, if it is not empty.

suffix.description: Text that is appended if the field content is not empty.

set.description: The content is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

relation.note: Outputs the main field (title) of all records that are linked to the current record.

id.description: Record whose relations are output. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL.

field.description: Name of the relation field (field type relation, pointer or link) whose targets are output. Another field type results in an error message.

limit.description: Maximum number of records included in the result set.

future.description: true: Targets not yet published (online_at not yet reached) are also output (as with CMS:SELECT).

archive.description: true: Expired targets (offline_at reached) are also output (as with CMS:SELECT).

state.description: Without specification, only released targets (status_id 0). A status ID > 0 only targets with this status, "any" targets of any status (as with CMS:SELECT).

lang.description: Code of the language version whose contents are requested (affects multilingual fields). Not yet implemented - currently the language of the call always applies.

separator.description: Text to be placed between the results.

prefix.description: Text that is placed before the source, if it is not empty.

suffix.description: Text that is appended to the source, if it is not empty.

ifempty.description: Text that becomes the source if the original source is empty (further parameters, except 'set', are ignored).

instead.description: Overrides the output, if it is not empty.

set.description: The output of the source is redirected and stored in $set.

result_end.note: Marks the end of a loop for processing CMS:SELECT results.

result_start.note: Marks the beginning of a loop for processing CMS:SELECT results.

savedata.note: Stores the data of the current record in the specified variable.

phpvar.description: Variable in which the data of the current record is to be stored.

id.description: Record whose data is to be loaded. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL. Without specification, the currently loaded record.

lang.description: Specifies in which language the contents of multilingual fields are to be loaded. Not yet implemented - currently always the language of the call applies.

select.note: Searches the database using the given (filter) criteria and returns the records found.

set.description: The entire output (including the included template) is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

resulttemplate.description: List template that is included to process the results.

noresulttemplate.description: Detail template that is included if the query returns no results.

noresult.description: Text that is output directly if the query returns no results.

filter.description: In the key: name of the field to search (relation_any for any link field; area for the name of the content area, a number there counts as area_id). In the value: the value to search for.

filter_mode.description: Mode in which several values of the same field are combined (filter_mode[field]=AND).

filter_op.description: Comparison operator for the given field (filter_op[field]=">"). Alternatively the operator stands between key and value (filter[price] > 100) or directly before the value (filter[price]=">100").

skip.description: Number of records skipped in the result set. Only works together with limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of records included in the result set - at the same time the page size for CMS:JUMP_LIST, CMS:JUMP_PREV and CMS:JUMP_NEXT. Without a value or 0: unlimited, no page navigation.

sort.description: Field to sort by (see order); several comma-separated or as sort[]=…; area sorts by the name of the content area, pointerfield.field by a field of the linked record.

order.description: Order in which to sort (see sort). Without sort, changed_at desc applies.

lang.description: Code of the language version whose contents are requested (affects multilingual fields). Not yet implemented - currently always the language of the call applies.

relation.description: Field names of relation/pointer fields in which the sought records are stored (with src_id); with dest_id the fields via which the sought records point to dest_id. ANY: any pointer field.

src_id.description: Source record whose links are evaluated (without a value: current record).

dest_id.description: Reverse direction to relation: the records that point to this record via relation (relation=ANY: via any pointer field). Without src_id, no current record is then used as the source.

nextof.description: Only with relation: neighbors of the given record in the link list - the entries after it (order=asc) or before it (order=desc), in the order of the list; with limit=1 the next or previous record.

count.description: true: The number of records in the result set is determined, regardless of "limit" and "skip" (in the resulttemplate in $this->db->num_rows_unlimited; basis of the JUMP commands).

hits.description: false: Only counts (includes count=true); no records are loaded and no resulttemplate is included. The total is then available in the calling template in $this->db->num_rows_unlimited; noresult/noresulttemplate apply if it is 0.

archive.description: true: Expired records (offline_at reached) are included in the query as well.

future.description: true: Pre-dated records (online_at not yet reached) are included in the query as well.

debug.description: true: The generated database query is output for support analysis.

sql.description: Raw SQL addition in the WHERE clause (caution: for support only!).

state.description: Without a value only released records (status_id 0). A status ID > 0 finds only records with this status; "any" finds records of every status.

select_langversion.note: Returns the available languages as records.

set.description: The entire output (including the included template) is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

resulttemplate.description: List template that is included to process the results.

snippet.note: Outputs a snippet (text module) in the language of the call.

key.description: Key of the snippet, e.g. custom.read_more (snippet set of the instance) or a core snippet without prefix.

param.description: Values for placeholders: param[name]=value replaces {name} in the snippet and fills ICU parameters (plural, select).

specialchars.description: true: Special characters are converted into their HTML equivalent (for attributes).

ifempty.description: Text that is output if the snippet does not exist (without ifempty, the key appears).

prefix.description: Text that is placed before the snippet, if it is not empty.

suffix.description: Text that is appended if the snippet is not empty.

set.description: The text is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

text.note: Outputs a text with formatting applied.

id.description: Record to read from. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL. Without 'field', the field "text" is read.

field.description: Name of a record field whose content is used as the source.

useval.description: Value in text form that is used as the source.

ifempty.description: Text that becomes the source if the original source is empty (further parameters, except 'set', are then ignored).

instead.description: Text that becomes the source if the original source is not empty.

entitydecode.description: true: Entities in the format &...; are converted back to Unicode characters.

trim.description: true: Spaces at the beginning and end of the text are removed.

striptags.description: true: HTML and script tags are removed.

if.description: If the source corresponds to the text before the question mark, the text after the question mark becomes the new source.

else.description: If none of the previous IF queries applies, this value becomes the source.

replace.description: If the text before the question mark occurs in the source, it is replaced by the text after the question mark.

limit.description: Shortens the text to the given number of characters and appends "…"; with an appended s (e.g. 200s) the text is shortened at the last word end.

lbrconvert.description:
true: Line breaks are converted into HTML line breaks (
tags).

specialchars.description: true: Special characters are converted into their HTML equivalent.

urlconvert.description: true: Internet addresses are automatically converted into clickable links.

emailconvert.description: true: Email addresses are linked. encrypt: The links are lightly encrypted by means of JavaScript.

emaillimit.description: Automatically shortens linked email addresses to x visible characters.

emailtext.description: Linked text that is shown instead of an email address (only if "emailconvert" is enabled).

target.description: Sets the link target for automatically generated links (urlconvert, emailconvert).

markdown.description: true: The text is Markdown and is converted into HTML (HTML in the text is escaped); the other conversions do not apply.

urlencode.description: true: The text is encoded according to RFC 1738.

urllimit.description: Maximum length of the visible text for automatically generated links (only suitable for external links!).

ampconvert.description: true: A standalone & is automatically converted into the HTML entity &.

prefix.description: Text that is placed before the source, if the source is not empty.

suffix.description: Text that is appended to the source, if the source is not empty.

iso.description: true: The output is converted into the character set ISO-8859-1.

charset.description: Character set into which the output should be converted.

set.description: The formatted value is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

time.note: Outputs the time of a date or time value, formatted.

id.description: Record to read from. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL.

field.description: Name of a record field whose content is used as the source.

useval.description: Value in text form that is used as the source.

format.description: ICU pattern, e.g. "HH:mm". Without specification, the locale of the page determines the notation; full minutes are shown without seconds.

timezone.description: true: The name of the time zone is appended (e.g. "Europe/Berlin").

replace.description: If the text before the question mark occurs in the formatted value, it is replaced by the text after the question mark (e.g. "Jan?January").

ifempty.description: Text that is output if the source ('field' or 'useval') is empty.

instead.description: Text that is output instead of the source, if it is not empty.

prefix.description: Text that is placed before the formatted value, if it is not empty.

suffix.description: Text that is appended if the formatted value is not empty.

set.description: The formatted value is not output, but stored in the variable $set.

url.note: Creates the URL of a record.

area.description: Link to the overview of the area: the address made of its slug prefix (/en/models), which its overview template shows.

id.description: Record to link to. Pure digit sequence = record_id, anything else = slug - the same rule as in the URL.

template.description: Template with which the record is to be shown (second part of the URL after the comma): name or area.name. Without specification, the template that the area assigns.

lang.description: Language version to link to (by default that of the current call). If the instance runs more than one language, the code always appears in the URL; with only one language, never. A code that the website does not run is ignored.

protocol.description: http or https, only with absolute or host. Without specification, the protocol of the instance, otherwise that of the call.

host.description: e.g. example.com to change the domain through which the website is called.

absolute.description: true: The path is generated including protocol and domain. false: The path is server-relative and begins with a slash.

set.description: The URL is not output, but stored in $set.

user_2fa.note: Shows, sets up (authenticator app or code by email) and switches off the second factor of the signed-in frontend user.

csrf.description: true: The request must contain a valid token from CMS:USER_TOKEN (protection against CSRF). false switches off the check for this command (caution: observe the security notes!).

function.description: status: read only. totp_setup: creates a new key for the app ($set['totp_setup']). totp_enable: checks and saves data[token] and data[code] ($set['recovery_codes']). code_enable: chooses the code by email (confirmed with the password). disable: switches off (app code or password). recovery_renew: new recovery codes (app code).
function.value: status / totp_setup / totp_enable / code_enable / disable / recovery_renew

submit.description: Writing functions run only if this field contains a text.

data.description: Name of the PHP array that contains the inputs.

codefield.description: Name of the input field for the code in data[…].

currentfield.description: Name of the input field for the password in data[…] (code_enable, disable with the code).

message.description: Error messages. In the index: use case; in the value: message text (see table).

user_auth.note: Checks a session ID for validity.

sessionid.description: Resumes the session of the frontend user with the given session ID instead of using a cookie.

filter.description: Filter criteria for the profile record that the signed-in frontend user must meet.

mode.description: Mode in which values that concern the same field are combined.

csrf.description: true: The request must contain a valid token from CMS:USER_TOKEN (protection against CSRF). false switches off the check for this command (caution: observe the security notes!).

overwrite.description: function=add + overwrite=true: The number of items already saved is updated when adding.

container.description: Only records from these containers get into the basket. Without specification: published records from containers of type “record” or “ugc” (never profiles).

variable.description: Name of the variable in which the item IDs are stored as an array.

duration.description: Number of days the basket stays saved, provided no changes are made.

user_delete.note: Deletes a record that belongs to the signed-in frontend user.

csrf.description: true: The request must contain a valid token from CMS:USER_TOKEN (protection against CSRF). false switches off the check for this command (caution: observe the security notes!).

ignoreuser.description: true: The record to be deleted need not belong to the signed-in frontend user (caution: observe the security notes!).

successtemplate.description: Template that is included when the entry has been deleted successfully.

message_error.description: Error message if the user has no access to the record.

user_input.note: Creates or updates a record from data that a frontend user has entered.

csrf.description: true: The request must contain a valid token from CMS:USER_TOKEN (protection against CSRF). false switches off the check for this command (caution: observe the security notes!).

successtemplate.description: Template that is included when the entry has been saved successfully.

data.description: Name of the PHP array that contains the data to be saved.

overwrite.description: Explicitly overwrites the input of the frontend user (including meta fields, except record_id, area_id, instance_id, tmp, deleted, origin_id, owner_id, created_by, changed_by). Do not pass on any input of the frontend user here!

container.description: ID or name of the content area in which the new record is to be saved.

message.description: Error message depending on the index (see table).

submit.description: The command runs only if this field contains a text.

fields.description: Names of the input fields that may be written. Empty = all fields defined for the container.

id.description: If given, an attempt is made to update this record (UPDATE). Otherwise a new one is created (CREATE).

ignoreuser.description: true: The record to be adjusted need not belong to the signed-in frontend user (caution: observe the security notes!).

forceupdate.description: true: Forces the update of the record given via the parameter “id”. On error, a message is output.

masterid.description: Only when creating in areas with a tree structure: parent node of the new record (parent_id).

owner.description: Only when creating: admin_id of the back-end owner (record.owner_id, created_by). If not given, user.default_owner_id applies.

removefiles.description: Names of the upload fields whose content is to be deleted.

currentfield.description: Only profile containers: name of the form field data[…] with the current password. A new password is saved only together with the current one - except directly after signing in via the reset link ($set['password_reset']). Message "current".

user_login.note: Checks the sign-in data of a frontend user and creates a new session.

codetemplate.description: Template for the second step of the sign-in if the profile area requires a second factor (code from the app or by email). For a code by email, it sends $set['login_code'] with CMS:EMAIL and shows the code form for CMS:USER_LOGIN_CODE. Required as soon as the area uses a second factor.

csrf.description: true: The request must contain a valid token from CMS:USER_TOKEN (protection against CSRF). false switches off the check for this command (caution: observe the security notes!).

successtemplate.description: Detail template that is included after a successful sign-in.

container.description: ID or name of the profile container in which the data of the frontend users is stored.

data.description: Name of the PHP array that contains the sign-in data.

message.description: Error messages. In the index: use case; in the value: message text (see the table).

hash.description: A sign-in can also be carried out by means of a hash (token from CMS:USER_PW, forgotten password).

trim.description: true: remove spaces at the beginning and end of the input.

cookie.description: true: a cookie is set by default to keep the sign-in across several pages.

submit.description: The command runs only if this field contains a text. Not applicable to sign-in by “hash”.

user_login_code.note: Second step of the sign-in: checks the code from the authenticator app, the code by email or a recovery code and signs the frontend user in.

codetemplate.description: Template that is included after "resend" and sends the new code ($set['login_code']) with CMS:EMAIL - usually the same as "codetemplate" of CMS:USER_LOGIN.

csrf.description: true: The request must contain a valid token from CMS:USER_TOKEN (protection against CSRF). false switches off the check for this command (caution: observe the security notes!).

successtemplate.description: Detail template that is included after the successful sign-in.

submit.description: The code is checked only if this field contains a text.

resend.description: true: creates a new code by email (throttled). It is then in $set['login_code']; "codetemplate" is included, which sends it with CMS:EMAIL.

data.description: Name of the PHP array that contains the inputs.

codefield.description: Name of the input field for the code in data[…].

message.description: Error messages. In the index: use case; in the value: message text (see table).

sessionid.description: Session of the waiting sign-in without a cookie (calls from apps) - $set['user_session_id'] after CMS:USER_LOGIN.

user_logout.note: Ends and deletes the session of a signed-in frontend user.

submit.description: If the parameter is given, the command signs out only if it contains a text (e.g. submit="$logout" from the sign-out form) - if it is empty, nothing happens, not even the message token. Without the parameter, the command signs out on every call (a valid token is assumed).

csrf.description: true: The request must contain a valid token from CMS:USER_TOKEN (protection against CSRF). false switches off the check for this command (caution: observe the security notes!).

deletecookie.description: false: Only the server-side session is deleted. true: The browser cookie is deleted as well.

user_password_rules.note: Outputs password rules and texts as JSON for the attribute data-c9-password (extension Password, included inline) - the same rules that the server checks when saving.

container.description: Profile container whose password field is meant.

field.description: Password field of the container. If it carries the extension Password, its rules apply, otherwise security.password_policy (the server then does not check).

set.description: The output is not printed, but stored in the variable $set.

user_protect.note: Protects a template from access by visitors who are not signed in.

errortemplate.description: Detail template that is included if the frontend user has no access to the container or is not signed in.

filter.description: Filter criteria for the profile record that the signed-in frontend user must meet.

sessionid.description: Resumes the session of the frontend user with the given session ID instead of using a cookie.

user_pw.note: Prepares the resetting of a password.

formguard.description: true: Form protection against robots - the form must contain the fields from (CMS:USER_TOKEN formguard=true) (timestamp, empty honeypot field) and may be submitted no earlier than after user.formguard_min_seconds (3). A number sets this minimum time for the form (formguard=5); 0 or false switches the protection off. Otherwise message "throttled", as with throttling.

csrf.description: true: The request must contain a valid token from CMS:USER_TOKEN (protection against CSRF). false switches off the check for this command (caution: observe the security notes!).

successtemplate.description: Detail template that is included if “uniquevalue” could be assigned to a profile in the field “uniquefield”.

errortemplate.description: Detail template that is included if “uniquevalue” was given but could not be assigned to a profile.

container.description: ID or name of the profile container in which the profiles to be matched are stored.

uniquefield.description: Name of the field to search by (field type chars, text or encrypted, e.g. “email”). The value must match exactly one profile.

uniquevalue.description: Value sought in the field “uniquefield”, e.g. $_POST[email].

submit.description: The command runs only if this field contains a text.

message.description: Error message. In the index: use case; in the value: message text (see table).

user_register.note: Creates a profile record from the data supplied and sets the status to status=2.

formguard.description: true: Form protection against robots - the form must contain the fields from (CMS:USER_TOKEN formguard=true) (timestamp, empty honeypot field) and may be submitted no earlier than after user.formguard_min_seconds (3). A number sets this minimum time for the form (formguard=5); 0 or false switches the protection off. Otherwise message "throttled", as with throttling.

csrf.description: true: The request must contain a valid token from CMS:USER_TOKEN (protection against CSRF). false switches off the check for this command (caution: observe the security notes!).

successtemplate.description: Detail template that is included after a successful registration.

container.description: ID or name of the profile container in which the data of the frontend users is to be saved.

emailfield.description: Name of the field in which the email address of the frontend user is saved (the confirmation link is sent there).

fields.description: Names of the input fields that may be written. Empty = all fields defined for the container.

overwrite.description: Explicitly overwrites the input of the frontend user (including meta fields, except record_id, area_id, instance_id, tmp, deleted, origin_id, owner_id, created_by, changed_by). Do not pass on any input of the frontend user here!

message.description: Error message. In the index: use case; in the value: message text (see the table at CMS:USER_INPUT).

submit.description: The command runs only if this field contains a text.

owner.description: admin_id of the back-end owner of the new profile (record.owner_id, created_by). If not given, user.default_owner_id applies.

data.description: Name of the PHP array that contains the data to be saved.

user_register_confirm.note: Activates a profile record and sets status=0.

successtemplate.description: Detail template that is included if the registration could be completed successfully.

hash.description: Hash ID created by CMS:USER_REGISTER and sent by email.

message.description: Error message. In the index: use case; in the value: message text (see table).

user_token.note: Outputs the CSRF token for a form with a writing CMS:USER_* command (hidden field _token).

formguard.description: true: additionally outputs a timestamp and an invisible honeypot field (form protection against robots) - for forms with USER_REGISTER, USER_PW or CMS:EMAIL formguard=true.

format.description: field: hidden input field <input type="hidden" name="_token">. value: only the token (for Ajax: header X-Camindo-Token or POST field _token).

set.description: The output is not printed, but stored in the variable $set. The token is additionally always in $set['user_token'].

zip.note: Offers the files of several records as a ZIP archive for download and ends the page.

field.description: Upload/thumbnail field(s). For each record, the first one that the visitor may retrieve applies (e.g. fil_print,fil_upload: print version for the press, otherwise web version).

filter.description: Selection of the records as with CMS:SELECT.

filter_mode.description: Combination of several values as with CMS:SELECT.

src_id.description: Source record for relation; empty or 0: no files.

ids.description: Explicitly named records (published, from this website).

source.description: basket: the records in the basket of the session (category from category) - for example a light box.

sort.description: Order as with CMS:SELECT; without specification, that of ids or of the basket.

filenames.description: File names in the archive: {slug}, {id}, {filename} (original name), {extension}, {fieldname}; duplicate names get -2, -3 ...

credits.description: Adds a CREDITS.txt: for each file its name and the contents of these fields (e.g. title, caption, image credit).

maxfiles.description: Maximum number of files (only smaller than the setting).

maxsize.description: Maximum size in MB (only smaller than the setting).

message.description: Messages: message[empty] (no file), message[limit] (too large), message[throttled] (too many archives).
